cards.mood: The piece opens with an atmosphere of suffocating tension and claustrophobia, driven by aggressive rhythmic density.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, down-tuned electric guitars provide the core harmonic weight, playing chugging, syncopated riffs in the verses and open, ringing power chords in the choruses.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a melancholic and atmospheric tension, utilizing clean textures to establish a sense of isolation.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, down-tuned electric guitars serve as the core harmonic driver, playing chugging palm-muted riffs in the verses and soaring, sustained power chords in the choruses.
